#!/usr/bin/env python3

import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

def test_model(model_name, skip_temperature=False):
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/chat/completions"
    payload = {
        "model": model_name,
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with exactly one word: OK"}],
        "max_tokens": 20,
    }
    if not skip_temperature:
        payload["temperature"] = 0.7

    data = json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})

    start = time.time()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read())
            latency = time.time() - start
            text = result["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
            return True, latency, text
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode(errors="replace")
        # Retry without temperature if it seems unsupported
        if not skip_temperature and ("temperature" in body.lower()):
            return test_model(model_name, skip_temperature=True)
        latency = time.time() - start
        return False, latency, body[:50]
    except Exception as e:
        latency = time.time() - start
        return False, latency, str(e)[:50]

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python solution.py <config.json>")
        sys.exit(1)

    with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
        models = json.load(f)

    if isinstance(models, dict):
        models = models.get("models", models.get("model_list", list(models.values())[0]))

    results = []
    for model in models:
        name = model if isinstance(model, str) else model.get("model", model.get("model_name", str(model)))
        ok, lat, text = test_model(name)
        results.append((name, ok, lat, text[:50]))

    # Print table
    name_w = max(len("Model"), max((len(r[0]) for r in results), default=5))
    print(f"{'Model':<{name_w}}  {'Status':<6}  {'Latency':>8}  Response")
    print(f"{'-'*name_w}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}  {'-'*50}")
    for name, ok, lat, text in results:
        status = "✅" if ok else "❌"
        print(f"{name:<{name_w}}  {status:<6}  {lat:>7.2f}s  {text}")

    working = sum(1 for r in results if r[1])
    failed = len(results) - working
    print(f"\nTotal: {len(results)} models | ✅ {working} working | ❌ {failed} failed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
